title: Wellness Trends 2026: What Brands Need to Know
summary: Explore the top wellness trends shaping 2026 with Google, TikTok, and Instagram search insights. Learn what's driving consumer demand and brand innovation.
body_markdown:
Wellness is no longer a category sitting on its own but a lens consumers are applying to every decision they make, from how they move and rest to how they process emotion and fuel their bodies. Across Google, TikTok, and Instagram, interaction volumes around wellness trends 2026 are accelerating in ways that should change how brands think about product development and messaging and where they choose to show up.


What makes this moment different from previous years is the sheer breadth of what consumers now consider wellness. The wellness industry in 2026 encompasses mental health and spirituality, recovery and ancient traditions, functional food, and even fragrance, all folded into daily wellness routines that consumers are building with real intention. The global wellness economy continues to expand, and the wellness market is being reshaped not by industry players telling consumers what health and wellness should look like but by consumers deciding for themselves.


This article draws on Spate's cross-platform behavioral data covering interaction signals across Google, TikTok, and Instagram to unpack the wellness trends of 2026 that matter most for brands and what they reveal about where consumer demand is heading next.


## **Global Wellness Trends Reshaping Consumer Behavior in 2026**


[Five trend territories](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/the-wellness-economy-5-global-trends-shaping-2026) are driving the most significant shifts in the wellness economy right now, and each one tells a different story about what consumers are prioritizing.


[Body in Motion](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/the-wellness-economy-5-global-trends-shaping-2026) is the largest territory with 1.1 billion in average monthly popularity and a combined year-over-year increase of 42.3%.[Running](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/the-wellness-economy-5-global-trends-shaping-2026) alone is up 37.2% YoY and has evolved far beyond a workout into a social ritual where Gen Z is showing up to run clubs for community as much as cardio, with platforms like Strava reporting that new run clubs grew 3.5-fold.[Reformer Pilates](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/the-wellness-economy-5-global-trends-shaping-2026) ranked as the world's most-booked workout on ClassPass for the third consecutive year, with 15 million bookings globally and a 366.7% YoY increase, and consumers are moving across the full intensity spectrum from calisthenics and[abs and core workouts](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/the-wellness-economy-5-global-trends-shaping-2026) (up 119.1% YoY) to low-impact options like pilates (up 24.7%) and at-home workouts that offer a low-cost alternative to gym memberships. The fitness landscape in 2026 is really about building a movement practice that fits into everyday lifestyle rather than committing to one single approach.


[Emotionally Literate](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/the-wellness-economy-5-global-trends-shaping-2026) is where things get particularly interesting for the mental health conversation. This territory hit 158.9 million in average monthly popularity with an 85.3% combined YoY increase, and[therapy](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/the-wellness-economy-5-global-trends-shaping-2026) interactions are up 68.5% ,while[burnout recovery](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/the-wellness-economy-5-global-trends-shaping-2026) is up over 1,000%, and[attachment styles](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/the-wellness-economy-5-global-trends-shaping-2026) have grown 227.4%. Shadow work, inner child healing, and counseling are not fringe topics anymore but mainstream wellness, and with 83% of workers globally reporting burnout in 2026 and Gen Z the hardest hit, consumers are actively interacting with terms like "recovery from burnout" and "styles of attachment" in ways that signal real intent to find solutions rather than just passive awareness of the problem.


[Spirit Forward](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/the-wellness-economy-5-global-trends-shaping-2026) reached 663.3 million in average monthly popularity with a 57.9% combined YoY increase as consumers seek connection and grounding through cosmic and alternative therapies frameworks like[energy healing](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/the-wellness-economy-5-global-trends-shaping-2026) ,[tarot reading](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/the-wellness-economy-5-global-trends-shaping-2026) ,[natal charts](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/the-wellness-economy-5-global-trends-shaping-2026) , and daily horoscopes. The WHO's adoption of the Global Traditional Medicine Strategy 2025–2034 adds institutional legitimacy to practices that were previously considered niche, and tarot is now used by 40% of US Millennials as a mindfulness tool rather than divination. Energy healing sits at 29.6 million popularity index, with its top related interaction queries being "energy healing" and "energy healer near me", which indicates consumers are moving from passive curiosity to actively seeking qualified practitioners.


[Rest as a Ritual](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/the-wellness-economy-5-global-trends-shaping-2026) carries 69.5 million in average monthly popularity and a 135.1% combined YoY increase , which makes it the highest growth rate territory of all five.[Sleep health](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/the-wellness-economy-5-global-trends-shaping-2026) is up over 1,000%,[rest days](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/the-wellness-economy-5-global-trends-shaping-2026) are up 429.9%, and[lymphatic drainage massage](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/the-wellness-economy-5-global-trends-shaping-2026) has grown 60.4%, and consumers are treating recovery with the same seriousness they give their training. The self-care conversation has matured well past face masks and bath bombs into structured recovery practices and health monitoring approaches where rest is reframed as a performance tool rather than time wasted.


[Built from Within](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/the-wellness-economy-5-global-trends-shaping-2026) rounds out the picture at 161.8 million in average monthly popularity with a 38.7% combined YoY increase.[Probiotics](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/the-wellness-economy-5-global-trends-shaping-2026) lead at 50.3 million popularity index (up 50.8% YoY), followed by[collagen boosters](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/the-wellness-economy-5-global-trends-shaping-2026) ****** (up 93.2%) and multivitamins and[electrolyte supplements](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/the-wellness-economy-5-global-trends-shaping-2026) (up 63.3%). What this shows is consumers investing in internal infrastructure through nutrition and gut health and supplementation as the foundation of their overall health, rather than chasing visible external results first.


## **How Search and Social Data Reveal Emerging Wellness Signals**


The wellness market has always been noisy, but what has changed is the ability to distinguish genuine consumer demand from surface-level hype. Spate's Popularity Index combines interaction data across Google, TikTok, and Instagram to measure how popular a trend is relative to others in the same industry and adjusts for growth differences on each platform.


Why this matters for brands is that each platform tells a different part of the story. Social media captures aspiration, where consumers build the persona of who they want to be, while Google captures intent and what people interact with when nobody is watching, which functions as a kind of digital truth serum that reveals an honest picture of consumer behavior. And according to correlative research, those interaction patterns are a strong indicator of future sales.


Take the "Built from Within" territory as an example.[Body detox](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/the-wellness-economy-5-global-trends-shaping-2026) has a 9.8 million in popularity index and is up 59.4% YoY, and the top related interaction queries include "detox body of heavy metals", which is a signal that consumer anxiety about environmental toxins is actively driving demand rather than just general wellness aspiration.[Electrolyte supplements](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/the-wellness-economy-5-global-trends-shaping-2026) at 7.5 million popularity (up 63.3% YoY) show brand-level awareness driving direct purchase intent globally, with consumers interacting with specific brand names rather than generic category terms.


The volatile trends section of the data is equally revealing for brands looking to get ahead because trends like[ear spa](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/2026-beauty-wellness-predictions-the-trends-set-to-shape-the-year-ahead) ,[lymphatic drainage supplements](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/2026-beauty-wellness-predictions-the-trends-set-to-shape-the-year-ahead) , and[skin smoothies](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/2026-beauty-wellness-predictions-the-trends-set-to-shape-the-year-ahead) are still at very low or low popularity, but they are predicted to grow 40–80% over the next twelve months. These represent the kind of early-stage opportunities that[timely trend identification](https://www.spate.nyc/blog/identify-consumer-trends-before-mainstream) can surface before they hit the mainstream marketplace.


The functional food and beverage space offers another lens into this shift.[THC drinks](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/2026-beauty-wellness-predictions-the-trends-set-to-shape-the-year-ahead) lead predicted growth at 58.5%, followed by[immunity shots](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/2026-beauty-wellness-predictions-the-trends-set-to-shape-the-year-ahead) (35.6%) and[probiotic drinks](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/2026-beauty-wellness-predictions-the-trends-set-to-shape-the-year-ahead) (34.6%), and consumer interactions around functional beverages focus on benefits like energy, detox & hydration, and being sugar-free, which are clear signals about what consumers want these wellness products to do as part of their daily wellness routines.


## **The Wellness Categories Showing the Strongest Momentum**


Across the data, several categories stand out for both their current scale and their trajectory, and they cut across what brands traditionally think of as separate markets.


Supplements and ingestibles are becoming embedded in everyday performance routines, and consumers are using them to support daily energy and cognitive performance, stress management, and recovery rather than to address a specific deficiency.[Magnesium gummies](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/2026-beauty-wellness-predictions-the-trends-set-to-shape-the-year-ahead) are predicted to grow 35.1% in the next year, with anxiety and sleep as the top related concerns in the data, and[creatine gummies](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/2026-beauty-wellness-predictions-the-trends-set-to-shape-the-year-ahead) are up 101.0% YoY, while[NAD supplements](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/guide-to-longevity-beauty-and-wellness) have grown 309.5% YoY, which reflects a longevity and cellular health mindset that has moved from biohacker circles into mainstream consumer behavior. The top supplement concerns consumers are interacting with include[gut health](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/2026-beauty-wellness-predictions-the-trends-set-to-shape-the-year-ahead) (up 2.8 million), yeast infections, magnesium deficiency, and cortisol face, and mood swings, and taken together, this paints a picture of a consumer who is using supplementation to address ongoing quality-of-life issues rather than acute problems.


Functional food and beverage continues to grow as a key access point to daily wellness.[Immunity shots](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/2026-beauty-wellness-predictions-the-trends-set-to-shape-the-year-ahead) illustrate this shift well because they are evolving from seasonal defense into daily wellness rituals with brands like Suja Organics and Vive Organic leading the space, and consumers interact with terms like "immunity shot recipe" alongside branded queries, which signals they are balancing trust in branded wellness products against homemade alternatives.[Protein bars](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/2026-beauty-wellness-predictions-the-trends-set-to-shape-the-year-ahead) (predicted to grow 29.2%) and[protein cookies](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/2026-beauty-wellness-predictions-the-trends-set-to-shape-the-year-ahead) (22.0%) show the functional snacking category expanding, while[mushroom drinks](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/2026-beauty-wellness-predictions-the-trends-set-to-shape-the-year-ahead) (30.1%) and[turmeric shots](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/2026-beauty-wellness-predictions-the-trends-set-to-shape-the-year-ahead) (25.2%) reflect the rising demand for functional beverages built around specific wellness benefits.


Mental health and emotional wellness are categories showing a significant structural shift.[Art therapy](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/the-wellness-economy-5-global-trends-shaping-2026) interactions are up 16.0% YoY, with a 2025 meta-analysis published in the Journal of Psychiatric and Mental Health Nursing confirming that visual art therapy reduces anxiety in adults, and[flow state](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/the-wellness-economy-5-global-trends-shaping-2026) is up 184.7% while[fidget toys](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/the-wellness-economy-5-global-trends-shaping-2026) continue to grow at 32.3% as an accessible self-regulation tool.[Counseling](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/the-wellness-economy-5-global-trends-shaping-2026) interactions have increased 203.3% YoY. This territory spans both clinical pathways, like therapy and antidepressants , and self-guided modalities like art therapy and flow state, and brands that want to play in this space need to understand that consumers are emotionally literate and quick to disengage from content that feels performative or reductive.


[Longevity and preventive medicine](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/guide-to-longevity-beauty-and-wellness) ***t*** ie all of this together. The concept of "healthspan," which means living longer in good health rather than just living longer, has become central to consumer behavior across both beauty and wellness.[Biohacking](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/guide-to-longevity-beauty-and-wellness) interactions are up 196.0% YoY,[circadian rhythm](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/guide-to-longevity-beauty-and-wellness) is up 91.4%,[longevity supplements](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/guide-to-longevity-beauty-and-wellness) are up 88.9%, and what this tells us is that consumers are approaching health with what amounts to a long-term investment strategy where probiotics and collagen and magnesium and creatine and anti-aging ingredients are not separate purchases anymore but building blocks in a system designed to support physical and mental health over decades.


## **What These Trends Mean for Brand Innovation**


The data points to several strategic implications that should shape how wellness brands think about product development and positioning and consumer engagement.


Movement and rest are two sides of the same bet. Running is up 37.2% YoY, abs workouts are up 119.1%, but rest days are up 429.9% , and sleep health is up over 1,000%, and rather than being a contradiction, this reflects a philosophy where performance and recovery are being treated as a single integrated system. The data suggests an opportunity for wellness products and messaging that support both the effort and the recovery rather than addressing only one half.


Inside-out is the new outside-in because the dominant wellness logic has shifted, and consumers are starting with what is foundational rather than what is visible. Whether physical through probiotics, collagen, and electrolytes, or psychological through therapy and burnout recovery and counseling, consumers are investing in internal infrastructure first. This means brands need to lead with function in their positioning because the consumer is already thinking that way. Personalized nutrition, targeted supplementation, and science-backed wellness solutions are the categories pulling the strongest consumer interaction volumes.


The mainstreaming of the margins is real and visible across the data.[Energy healing](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/the-wellness-economy-5-global-trends-shaping-2026) is at 29.6 million on the popularity index,[shadow work](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/the-wellness-economy-5-global-trends-shaping-2026) went up 423.1%, and[inner child healing](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/the-wellness-economy-5-global-trends-shaping-2026) by 253.6%. What's amazing about these trends is that the biggest spikes are from the ones that were relatively unpopular. Ancient traditions, alternative therapies, and practices that sat on the margins of wellness for years are now showing up in mainstream interaction volumes. Brands that want to enter these spaces need to bring real depth because the interaction data shows consumers in these categories engage with credibility.


The wellness industry is also increasingly overlapping with beauty through the ongoing acceleration of[skinification](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/2026-beauty-wellness-predictions-the-trends-set-to-shape-the-year-ahead) ****** , which refers to the practice of applying skincare-grade formulas across beauty categories.[Skin tints](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/2026-beauty-wellness-predictions-the-trends-set-to-shape-the-year-ahead) are predicted to grow 32.4% and,[scalp serums](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/guide-to-longevity-beauty-and-wellness) are up 116.4%, and[serum body washes](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/guide-to-longevity-beauty-and-wellness) are up over 4,000%, and consumers expect the same ingredient literacy and functional benefits across every product in their routine, which creates development opportunities for brands willing to bridge wellness and beauty with scientific research and credible formulations.


## **How Brands Can Identify the Next Wellness Opportunity**


The wellness trends 2026 covered in this article represent what the data shows right now, including the categories, behaviors, and consumer demands that are already reshaping the global market, but the real competitive advantage lies in identifying what comes next before it scales.


Volatile trends in the data are the early signals because they carry lower overall volume but strong predicted growth.[Low-lift passive wellness](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/2026-beauty-wellness-predictions-the-trends-set-to-shape-the-year-ahead) , including ear spa and lymphatic drainage supplements and high fiber protein bars, is predicted to grow 46.7% YoY, and[treatment-in-a-bottle](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/2026-beauty-wellness-predictions-the-trends-set-to-shape-the-year-ahead) trends like liquid micro needling and multi peptide serums and growth factor serums carry 40.0% predicted growth.[Wellness going topical](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/2026-beauty-wellness-predictions-the-trends-set-to-shape-the-year-ahead) through magnesium flakes, sleep lotions, and GLP-1 patches shows 36.4% predicted growth and an 870.6% combined YoY increase that signals rapid consumer adoption of these formats.


[The brands that won wellness in 2025](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/the-brands-that-won-wellness-in-2025) offer a blueprint here.[Goli](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/the-brands-that-won-wellness-in-2025) reached 217.7% YoY growth in popularity with its ashwagandha and apple cider vinegar gummy lineup and strong TikTok Shop presence.[Nello](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/the-brands-that-won-wellness-in-2025) grew 194.1% alongside rising consumer interaction with stress relief and cortisol-related content.[Alani Nu](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/the-brands-that-won-wellness-in-2025) hit 150.0% growth with its energy drink and supplement lineup.[Built Bar](https://www.spate.nyc/reports/the-brands-that-won-wellness-in-2025) grew over 1,000% with its protein bar and puff formats gaining traction on TikTok Shop.


The pattern across all of these winners is consistent in that functional benefits drove brand growth, while TikTok and creator-led storytelling fueled momentum, and related consumer interactions reveal a symptom-driven pathway where consumers move from a problem to an ingredient solution to a brand. The wellness brands that can meet consumers along that pathway with credible ingredients, clear benefits, and platform-native content are the ones positioned to capture rising demand in the wellness marketplace.


For brands looking to make informed decisions about where to invest, the challenge is not access to data but rather knowing which signals to prioritize and when to act. The wellness economy rewards brands that move on emerging trends with conviction and penalizes those that wait for mainstream validation before entering.

## **FAQs**


### **What are the top wellness trends in 2026?**


The top wellness trends in 2026 span five key territories based on cross-platform interaction data from Google, TikTok, and Instagram. Body in Motion leads with 1.1 billion in average monthly popularity driven by running (up 37.2% YoY) and reformer Pilates (up 366.7%), and at-home workouts, while Emotionally Literate follows at 158.9 million popularity with burnout recovery up over 1,000% and therapy interactions up 68.5%. Spirit Forward and Rest as a Ritual and Built from Within round out the landscape, covering everything from energy healing and tarot to sleep health and probiotics and electrolyte supplements, and longevity and preventive health also emerged as cross-cutting themes, with biohacking up 196.0% and NAD supplements up 309.5% YoY.


### **How are consumers redefining wellness?**


Consumers are redefining wellness by treating it as a comprehensive support system rather than a single-category pursuit. The data shows that physical and mental health are no longer separate conversations because consumers interact with burnout recovery and running content in the same breath, and they are building wellness routines that integrate fitness and nutrition, emotional health, rest, and even spirituality. Gen Z in particular is driving this shift, with 42% of US Gen Z reporting being in therapy and 77% engaging in self-care practices, and the expansion of what counts as wellness from shadow work and attachment styles to functional food and lymphatic drainage, reflects a consumer who expects wellness to address the full spectrum of their physical, emotional, and spiritual needs.


### **Which wellness categories are growing fastest?**


Rest as a Ritual is the fastest-growing territory by combined YoY growth at 135.1%, with sleep health up over 1,000% and rest days up 429.9%. Emotionally Literate follows at 85.3% combined YoY growth led by burnout recovery (over 1,000%) and shadow work (423.1%), and within supplements, NAD supplements grew 309.5% YoY, and creatine gummies grew 101.0%. In functional food and beverage, THC drinks lead predicted growth at 58.5%, and immunity shots are predicted to grow 35.6%, and volatile early-stage trends like wellness going topical through magnesium flakes and sleep lotions , and GLP-1 patches show 870.6% combined YoY growth, which signals categories that are scaling rapidly from a smaller base.


### **How can brands identify emerging wellness trends?**


Brands can identify emerging wellness trends by monitoring cross-platform interaction data for signals of rising consumer interest before those signals translate into mainstream demand. Volatile trends with lower current popularity but strong predicted growth are the earliest indicators, and the Spate data tracks over 60,000 trends and adds over 1,000 new hashtags weekly to surface emerging patterns across Google, TikTok, and Instagram. The key is distinguishing between social aspiration, which is what consumers post about, and genuine intent, which is what they interact with privately, and then tracking the pathway from concern to ingredient to brand that successful wellness companies follow.


### **Why is predictive trend forecasting important in wellness?**


Predictive trend forecasting matters in wellness because the gap between early signal and mainstream adoption is where competitive advantage is built. The brands that won wellness in 2025, including Goli, Nello, Alani Nu, and Built Bar, captured market momentum by aligning with consumer demand before it peaked, and reformer Pilates was flagged as a rising trend before it became the world's most-booked workout. Brands that rely on backward-looking sales data or wait for mainstream validation before entering a category consistently lose ground to those using predictive interaction data to anticipate where the wellness market is heading, and in a wellness economy where consumer demands shift rapidly, actionable insights from timely data are a powerful tool for making informed decisions about innovation and positioning and go-to-market strategy
